subject: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation follow-up
messages:
From: Angela Ramos <angela.ramos@finsecure.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinSecure Security <security@finsecure.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation follow-up

Hi Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap on our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can decide whether we need Dedicated capacity or go with a Private (VPC / on-prem) deployment.

Recap: We want strong data isolation for customer PII and transaction logs. Our security team flagged three must-haves:
- Network isolation (VPC + no public ingress)
- Customer-managed KMS for key separation
- Audit log retention for 7 years and ability to export on demand

Questions:
1) Can Redwood Dedicated be provisioned inside our VPC, or is Dedicated always managed in Redwood's subnet?
2) If we use Private VPC, does Redwood support on-prem offline deployment, and how long is the typical lead time for that?
3) Are the audit logs fully exportable and do they contain token-level detail (request/response IDs, timestamps)?

We are leaning toward Private VPC if Dedicated can't meet the KMS + full VPC isolation requirements, but timeline is also tight — procurement wants a recommended path by EOD Friday.

I attached our current security checklist. Happy to jump on a short follow-up call.

Thanks,
Angela
Director, Platform Security
FinSecure

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Angela Ramos <angela.ramos@finsecure.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation follow-up

Thanks for the clear recap, Angela — great to talk earlier. Below are direct answers and suggested next steps so you can share with procurement/security.

Short answers to your questions:
1) Redwood Dedicated: Dedicated capacity is tenant-isolated compute that we operate in our cloud regions. It is NOT deployed inside a customer's VPC by default. However, we offer a Private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem) for customers that require their own network boundary.
2) Private (VPC/on-prem): We support two private modes: a) Private VPC (customer-managed VPC peering or private endpoints + customer KMS integration) — typically 3–6 weeks to provision and test; b) On-prem (air-gapped) deployments — longer, typically 8–12 weeks depending on procurement and network readiness.
3) Audit logs: We provide token-level request logs, timestamps, and request/response IDs. For Private deployments we can configure longer retention and scheduled exports. For Hosted/Dedicated we offer standard retention (90 days) with enterprise add-ons for extended retention/export.

What I recommend for FinSecure given the requirements and timeline:
- If timeline < 6 weeks and KMS + strict VPC isolation is mandatory, we can propose a Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS and exportable audit logs. That meets all three must-haves.
- If timeline is more constrained and you can accept managed network isolation plus strict contractual controls (SLA + SOC2 + Bring-Your-Own-Key for some keys), we can provision Dedicated capacity and add a network-level private endpoint + customer KMS for encryption-at-rest, but note this will not place the nodes inside your VPC (it remains in Redwood-managed subnets).

I've attached a short one-pager (Redwood_Dedicated_vs_Private_Summary.pdf) that maps features to the two options and a draft SOW for the Private deployment.

Next steps I propose:
- I can book a 30-minute call with our Solutions Engineer (Dev) and our Private deployment lead (Vivek) to walk security/procurement through the architecture and timelines.
- If procurement wants to move fast, we can start with an NDA + SOW signature to lock resources while security finishes the checklist.

Available times for a call: Thu 11/18 10–12 PST, Fri 11/19 9–11 PST. Which works best?

Best,

Angela — thanks for the quick decision note. Based on procurement's feedback earlier today, it looks like FinSecure cannot commit to the lead time for on-prem. Procurement asked whether we can provide:

- A formal recommended path that balances security and time-to-production: we propose start with Dedicated + private endpoints + BYOK (short term, ~2 weeks provisioning) and a parallel project to stand up Private VPC (3–6 weeks).
- A draft SOW for the private engagement (attached: SOW-draft-FinSecure.docx).
- A sample sanitized audit export and KMS/HSM support summary — Dev will send this directly to your security mailing list.

If that approach works, our operational playbook would be:
1) Sign SOW for Dedicated + initial controls to get production traffic in 2 weeks.
2) Kick Private VPC project in parallel with a committed timeline and migration checkpoints.
3) Validate audit exports and rotation during the Dedicated runbook and sign-off before cold cutover.

Angela / Procurement — please confirm if you want us to generate the formal migration plan and a cost estimate for both phases. If yes, we'll produce a short mutual action plan (MAP) and target dates by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — I'll have Dev share the sanitized export and Vivek will prepare the migration checklist.
